steps.en: Offender logs in via Singpass to the portal to open the Clearance Slip service
steps.id: Offender login Singpass ke portal untuk membuka layanan Clearance Slip
steps.why_en: Singpass login exists, but there is no Clearance Slip page or menu.
steps.why_id: Login Singpass ada, tapi tidak ada halaman atau menu Clearance Slip.

steps.en: Offender's NRIC is taken from the login session
steps.id: NRIC offender diambil dari sesi login
steps.why_en: NRIC lookup exists only for parking fines, not for clearance slips.
steps.why_id: Pencarian per NRIC hanya ada untuk denda parkir, bukan untuk clearance slip.

steps.en: System checks for permanently suspended warrants under the NRIC in the past X months
steps.id: Sistem cek warrant yang permanently suspended atas NRIC dalam X bulan terakhir
steps.why_en: No check for permanently suspended warrants or the X-month window exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan warrant suspended atau batas X bulan di code.

steps.en: If no record is found, the e-service shows a no-records message for the NRIC
steps.id: Jika tidak ada record, e-service menampilkan pesan tidak ada record atas NRIC
steps.why_en: Only a generic empty message exists on the fines payment page, not a clearance slip message.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pesan kosong generik di halaman bayar denda, bukan pesan clearance slip.

steps.en: Offender knows there is no clearance slip to download or print
steps.id: Offender tahu tidak ada clearance slip untuk di-download atau di-print
steps.why_en: The only slip printing is the payment receipt, not a clearance slip.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya cetak slip adalah receipt pembayaran, bukan clearance slip.
